text:
alex: Midday climb in the office gym today — thinking of trying a 'spotter roulette' + rope-swap. Who's in? :mountain:

maria: I'm down, but need a belay refresher. Quick run-through ok?

jess: Wish I could, OOO today. Next time pls!

sam: In. I can bring an extra rope, chalk, and a small quickdraw set.

alex: Awesome. Can someone also bring a spare harness (M/L)? Forgot mine at home :facepalm:

maria: I have a spare harness, size M. Bringing it.

alex: Poll: 12:30 or 1:15? Reply with 12:30 or 1:15

sam: 1:15

maria: 12:30

alex: Sweet. Looks like split — leaning 12:30. If you prefer 1:15 reply again.

safety-bot: Reminder: everyone must sign the gym waiver. Sign here: https://redwood.gym/waiver

alex: Also reminder: helmets optional but recommended for top rope drills. @jess tagging you for next week's slot

maria: can we do a 10-min anchor/rope-check refresher at the top? Just in case.

sam: Yup, plan 10-min safety check then climb.

alex: Cool. See you all at the ground floor gym (bring water). :sweat_smile:
